crossRefs.note: “ ‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad.…
crossRefs.keyword: as thou valuest it, who art the priest. Heb. according tothy estimation, O priest, etc

translations.web: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.
translations.bsb: The priest shall set its value, whether high or low; as the priest values it, the price will be set.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest,
translations.asv: and the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou the priest valuest it, so shall it be.
